sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last six games before that defeat. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who sit bottom of the division with just four points and are winless in their last five outings, making this a favourable fixture for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall, who sit fifth and have won their most recent game, in a clash between two strong mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table and in excellent recent form with three consecutive wins, visit Wednesfield Community at home before facing Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening. In-form Bilston Town (sixth) host Foley Meir, while struggling Shawbury United face another tough test at home against Barnton. Market Drayton Town, rebuilding after a recent poor run, travel to face New Mills, and there are also fixtures involving Brereton Social hosting Widnes Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads away at Telford Town, and Crewe hosting Allscott Heath—all matches that will help define the season's trajectory for clubs across the bottom and middle sections of the table.
